name: J J Finance Corporation Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1982, J J Finance Corporation Ltd is in the business of investment and other financial services.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
JJFCL used to be in the business of Electricity Generation, Leasing, hire purchase, Finance, Real Estate, Investments, and dealing
 in Shares and Securities. Currently, it is registered as a Non-Systemically Important Non-Deposit-taking Non-Banking Financial Company

pros: Stock is trading at 1.05 times its book value
Promoter holding has increased by 1.72% over last quarter.
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 260 days to 51.5 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 2.50% over last 3 years.
